# FilterSelect

## Description
FilterSelect picks one value from a short fixed list, as a list filter or as a form field, in an in-app menu that follows the theme.

`import { FilterSelect } from "@/components/app"`, source `components/filter-select.tsx`, status `ready-with-gaps`.
Foundation: `Select (base-nova, @base-ui/react)` through `components/ui/select.tsx`. Traps checked: `trap/native-control` (Foundation), `trap/field-label` (ARIA, rule), `trap/select-empty-value` (Rules), `trap/select-value-lost` (State precedence), `trap/overlay-no-max-height` (States), `trap/overlay-focus-return` (Keyboard), `trap/open-trigger-unfocused` (States, finding), `trap/control-height` (Variants, rule), `trap/focus-ring-shape` (Tokens), `trap/escape-nested` (Keyboard), `trap/select-async` n/a because options arrive as a prop and nothing searches.

### Foundation
| Given by the foundation | Added by the team |
|---|---|
| `Select.Root`, `Trigger`, `Value`, `Portal`, `Positioner`, `Popup`, `List` and `Item` from `@base-ui/react/select`: combobox and listbox roles, arrow keys, type-ahead, Escape, focus return, `--available-height` | One `options` array of `{ value, label }` passed as `items`, so the trigger shows the label, not the raw value |
| `components/ui/select.tsx` (base-nova): trigger with chevron, popup fade and zoom over 100ms, check icon on the selected item, scroll buttons | `onChange` that fires only for string values, dropping a `null` from the primitive |
| Trigger heights `data-[size=default]:h-8` and `data-[size=sm]:h-7` | Its own `size` axis: `default` is 40px and full width, `compact` is 36px, `w-auto` and `min-w-40` for filter bars |
| `align="center"` and `alignItemWithTrigger` on by default | Popup aligned to the trigger's start edge, below it, capped at `max-h-72`, and a `bg-background` trigger with no shadow. It replaces the native `<select>`, whose system menu opens white in dark mode (`components/filter-select.tsx:14`) |

Default: `docs/system/examples/filter-select/default.tsx`, a category field with a visible label.

Example: A 40px form field for the product category, tied to its visible label by id (`docs/system/examples/filter-select/default.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterSelect } from '@/components/app';

const CATEGORIES = ['Fish', 'Poultry', 'Beef', 'Other'];

export default function FilterSelectDefault() {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('Fish');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-sm gap-1.5">
      <label htmlFor="example-category" className="text-sm font-medium">
        Category
      </label>
      <FilterSelect
        id="example-category"
        value={category}
        onChange={setCategory}
        options={CATEGORIES.map((c) => ({ value: c, label: c }))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

Example: Two compact filters in the sales filter bar, beside search and the result count (`docs/system/examples/filter-select/in-filter-bar.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterBar } from '@/components/app/filter-bar';
import { FilterSelect } from '@/components/app';

export default function FilterSelectInFilterBar() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [agent, setAgent] = useState('');
  const [channel, setChannel] = useState('');
  return (
    <FilterBar
      search={{ value: q, onChange: setQ, placeholder: 'Search customer or sale ID', label: 'Search sales' }}
      filters={
        <>
          <FilterSelect
            size="compact"
            ariaLabel="Agent"
            value={agent || 'All'}
            onChange={(v) => setAgent(v === 'All' ? '' : v)}
            options={[
              { value: 'All', label: 'All agents' },
              { value: 'a1', label: 'Ada Okafor' },
              { value: 'a2', label: 'Tunde Bello' },
            ]}
          />
          <FilterSelect
            size="compact"
            ariaLabel="Channel"
            value={channel || 'All'}
            onChange={(v) => setChannel(v === 'All' ? '' : v)}
            options={[
              { value: 'All', label: 'All channels' },
              { value: 'WhatsApp', label: 'WhatsApp' },
              { value: 'Walk-in', label: 'Walk-in' },
            ]}
          />
        </>
      }
      resultLabel="1 to 50 of 812 sales"
    />
  );
}
```

## Variants

### size
- `default`: 40px, full width, for a form field under its label. Used at 62 call sites, 45 of them overriding the height to 36px through `className`.
- `compact`: 36px, `w-auto`, at least 10rem wide, for a FilterBar `filters` slot or a toolbar. Used at 2 call sites, the head-to-head pickers `app/(app)/analytics/location-head-to-head.tsx:162`; `rule/filter-select-compact-size` moves the hand-sized filters onto it.

Example: A 36px status filter with an All option first, mapped back to no filter in onChange (`docs/system/examples/filter-select/size-compact.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FilterSelect } from '@/components/app';

export default function FilterSelectCompact() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  return (
    <FilterSelect
      size="compact"
      ariaLabel="Sale status"
      value={status || 'All'}
      onChange={(v) => setStatus(v === 'All' ? '' : v)}
      options={[
        { value: 'All', label: 'Any status' },
        { value: 'Paid', label: 'Paid' },
        { value: 'Part paid', label: 'Part paid' },
        { value: 'Unpaid', label: 'Unpaid' },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## States
| State | Trigger | What the user can do | Shown by, besides color | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Closed | Default | Open with click, Enter, Space or an arrow key | The selected option's label and a chevron | screenshot |
| Focused | Tab onto the trigger | Open it | 3px ring at `--ring` 50% and a `--ring` border | by hand |
| Open | Trigger pressed | Move through options, type to jump, pick one, or close with Escape or an outside click | `aria-expanded="true"`, popup below the trigger's start edge. The trigger itself looks as it does at rest (finding) | snapshot |
| Option highlighted | Pointer over an option or arrow keys | Pick it with Enter or a click | `--accent` fill on the option | by hand |
| Option selected | The option's value equals `value` | Pick another | Check icon at the option's end, `aria-selected="true"` | a11y scan |
| Value not in options | `value` matches no option, such as `''` from a `?? ''` fallback | Open and pick a real option | The trigger shows the raw value, so `''` shows an empty trigger, and no option has a check | by hand |
| Popup taller than the screen | More options than fit in `max-h-72` or `--available-height` | Scroll the list, or use the scroll buttons | Scroll arrows at the top and bottom of the list | by hand |
| Trigger hover | Pointer over the trigger | Click | Dark mode only: fill moves from `--input` 30% to 50%. Light mode has no hover change | by hand |

### State precedence
- Open and focused: open wins. Focus moves into the list, so the trigger loses its ring while the popup shows.
- Value not in options and option selected: Not applicable: a value that matches no option leaves every option unselected.
- Open and value not in options: both show. The empty trigger stays and the list opens with nothing checked.
- Open and trigger hover: open wins. The dark hover fill applies, but the open popup is the only open cue.
- Option highlighted and option selected: both show. The highlighted option gets the accent fill and the selected one keeps its check.
- Closed after a refetch of `options`: the value wins. FilterSelect keeps whatever `value` the caller holds, and the label updates when the new options contain it.

### Motion
| Trigger | Kind | Preset | Properties | Reduced motion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Popup opens or closes | announce | `duration-100` with `tw-animate-css` fade-in-0, zoom-in-95 and slide-in-from-top-2 (`components/ui/select.tsx`) | opacity, transform | Same 100ms fade, zoom and slide. No `prefers-reduced-motion` rule in `app/globals.css` covers it (finding) |
| Pointer enters or leaves the trigger | input | `transition-colors` (Tailwind default 150ms) | background-color, border-color | Same colour change. Nothing moves |

## Props

<!-- Props generated from components/filter-select.tsx with TypeScript by scripts/props-table.mjs -->
| Prop | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `options` | `FilterOption[]` |  |  |
| `value` | `string` |  |  |
| `ariaLabel?` | `string` |  |  |
| `className?` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `icon?` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `id?` | `string` |  |  |
| `size?` | `"default" \| "compact"` | `"default"` | compact = 36px, for filter bars. |

- `value` is the selected option's `value`. Keep it inside `options`; see `rule/filter-select-all-option`.
- `onChange` gets the picked option's `value` string, once per pick.
- `options` is the list of `{ value, label }`, rendered in order, as a `FilterOption[]`.
- `size` is `default` (40px, full width) or `compact` (36px, filter bars).
- `ariaLabel` names the trigger when no visible label sits beside it.
- `id` goes on the trigger, so a `<label htmlFor>` or `FormField` names it.
- `icon` renders before the value inside the trigger.
- `className` goes on the trigger and merges after the size classes, so it can override height and width.

## Usage

### When to use
- A list screen filter with 2 to 30 fixed choices, such as status, agent, channel or record type.
- A form field that picks one value from a fixed list, such as category or unit of measure.

### When not to use
- Choosing the location a screen reports on. Use LocationSelect instead.
- Choosing a date window. Use PeriodSelect instead.
- Two or three choices that should stay visible at once. Use Segmented instead.
- Options that need groups, separators or custom item content. Use Select instead.

### Rules
- `rule/filter-select-all-option`: When a filter can be off, put a first option with a real value such as `'All'` and map it to empty in `onChange`, because a `value` outside `options` shows the raw value, so `''` renders an empty trigger with nothing checked and no way back to "no filter". Evidence: app 21/64 call sites carry an `'All'` or `'all'` option, such as `app/(app)/sales/sales-filter-bar.tsx:45` and `app/(app)/audit/page.tsx:193`, and `app/(app)/settings/sheet-select.tsx:18` maps `''` to a sentinel for the same reason. Check: review that `value` falls back to the first option's value.
  - Don't: `<FilterSelect ariaLabel="Agent" value={agent} onChange={setAgent} options={agents} />`
  - Do: `<FilterSelect ariaLabel="Agent" value={agent || 'All'} onChange={(v) => setAgent(v === 'All' ? '' : v)} options={[{ value: 'All', label: 'All agents' }, ...agents]} />`
- `rule/filter-select-accessible-name`: When FilterSelect renders, give it `ariaLabel` or an `id` that a `<label htmlFor>` points at, because the trigger is a combobox whose text is only the current value, so with neither it is announced as "Fish, combobox" with no field name. Evidence: app 64/64 call sites pass `ariaLabel` (33) or `id` (33), such as `app/(app)/audit/page.tsx:185` and `app/(app)/engagement/feedback-form.tsx:107`. Check: review each `<FilterSelect` for `ariaLabel=` or `id=`.
  - Don't: `<FilterSelect value={stage} onChange={setStage} options={STAGE_FILTERS} />`
  - Do: `<FilterSelect ariaLabel="Stage" value={stage} onChange={setStage} options={STAGE_FILTERS} />`
- `rule/filter-select-compact-size`: When FilterSelect sits in a FilterBar `filters` slot or a toolbar row, pass `size="compact"` instead of writing `h-9 w-auto min-w-40 data-[size=default]:h-9` in `className`, because the hand-written classes drift in width (`min-w-32`, `min-w-36`, `min-w-40`) and break when the primitive's `data-[size]` height changes. Evidence: single use `components/filter-select.tsx:33`, the prop's own note "compact = 36px, for filter bars"; app 45/64 call sites set 36px by hand, such as `app/(app)/kitchen/jobs.tsx:166` and `app/(app)/inventory/stock-tab.tsx:181`. Check: review `className` on each `<FilterSelect` for `h-9`.
  - Don't: `<FilterSelect ariaLabel="Category" value={category} onChange={setCategory} options={options} className="h-9 w-auto min-w-40 data-[size=default]:h-9" />`
  - Do: `<FilterSelect size="compact" ariaLabel="Category" value={category} onChange={setCategory} options={options} />`

### Content
- `rule/filter-select-off-label`: When the first option turns a filter off, label it "All {plural noun}" for a set of things or "Any {noun}" for a state, in sentence case, because the closed trigger shows only that label and it must read as "no filter" at a glance. Evidence: app 27/27 options with value `'All'` or `'all'` read "All ..." or "Any ...", such as "Any status" at `app/(app)/sales/sales-filter-bar.tsx:42`, "All channels" at `app/(app)/sales/sales-filter-bar.tsx:48` and "All records" at `app/(app)/audit/page.tsx:193`. Check: review the first option's label.
  - Don't: `{ value: 'All', label: 'All' }`
  - Do: `{ value: 'All', label: 'All channels' }`

### Anti-slop
- `rule/filter-select-no-empty-fallback`: When a record's field can be missing, default `value` to a real option such as `'none'` with the label "Choose a product" instead of `?? ''`, because `''` matches no option and the field renders blank with no check. Evidence: app 60/64 call sites hold a value from their options, such as `app/(app)/inventory/forms/form-bits.tsx:24` with `'none'`, and the 4 strays are `app/(app)/inventory/forms/edit-sku-form.tsx:156`, `app/(app)/inventory/forms/edit-sku-form.tsx:159`, `app/(app)/inventory/forms/edit-sku-form.tsx:166` and `app/(app)/inventory/forms/create-sku-form.tsx:295`. Check: review `?? ''` inside `value=` on a `<FilterSelect`.
  - Don't: `<FilterSelect id="edit-category" value={product.category ?? ''} onChange={setCategory} options={CATEGORIES} />`
  - Do: `<FilterSelect id="edit-category" value={product.category ?? 'none'} onChange={setCategory} options={[{ value: 'none', label: 'Choose a category' }, ...CATEGORIES]} />`

### Limits
Not applicable: the popup caps at `max-h-72` and scrolls, and no call site's option count or label width was measured at 390px this session, so no break point is known yet.

## Accessibility
Rests on the Base UI Select: a `<button>` with `role="combobox"` that opens a `listbox` of `option` elements.

### Keyboard
| Key | Where focus is | Effect | Focus after | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enter, Space, ArrowDown or ArrowUp | Trigger | Opens the list | The selected option, or the first one | by hand |
| ArrowDown or ArrowUp | List | Moves the highlight one option | The next or previous option | by hand |
| Home or End | List | Moves to the first or last option | That option | by hand |
| Letter keys | List | Type-ahead to the first label starting with them | The matched option | by hand |
| Enter or Space | An option | Picks it, fires `onChange` and closes | The trigger | by hand |
| Escape | List | Closes without a change. Not yet checked inside a FormSheet for `trap/escape-nested` | The trigger | by hand |
| Tab | List | Closes the list and moves on | The next control after the trigger | by hand |

### ARIA
| Part | Role | Accessible name from | States and properties | Announced | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trigger | combobox | `ariaLabel`, or the `<label htmlFor>` matching `id` | `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-controls` while open | "Agent, All agents, combobox, collapsed" | snapshot |
| List | listbox | none of its own | none | "list box" on open | a11y scan |
| Option | option | Its label text | `aria-selected="true"` on the current value | "Tunde Bello, selected" | a11y scan |

## Tokens
| Part | State | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Trigger | rest | `--input` (border), `--background`; dark `--input` at 30% |
| Trigger | hover | dark only `--input` at 50% |
| Trigger | focus | `--ring` (border) and `--ring` at 50% (3px ring), drawn on the trigger's `rounded-md` |
| Trigger | value not in options | `--muted-foreground` for the placeholder slot |
| Chevron | all | `--muted-foreground` |
| Popup | open | `--popover`, `--popover-foreground`, `--foreground` at 10% (ring), `shadow-md` |
| Option | highlighted | `--accent`, `--accent-foreground` |

## Related
- FilterBar: holds compact FilterSelects in its `filters` slot on list screens.
- PeriodSelect: the date window beside them in the same bar.
- LocationSelect: built on FilterSelect for the location scope.
- Select: the primitive under it, for groups and custom items.
